# Choreographr

> An all-purpose, extensible AI agent written in Rust. A persistent daemon owns
> your sessions; clients for terminal, desktop, Telegram and ACP editors come
> and go. LLM-generated code runs in a sandboxed RISC-V VM, and 70+ model
> providers work out of the box. Open source, Apache-2.0.

## What is Choreographr?

Choreographr is an AI agent system built in 100% Rust: one server (the daemon)
runs every session, and multiple clients connect to it — a terminal UI
(`choreo-tui`), a desktop app (`choreo-gui`), a Telegram bridge (`choreo-im`),
and an ACP bridge for editors like Claude Code and Cline. LLM-generated code is
compiled to RISC-V and executed in an isolated `ckb-vm` sandbox: no host
memory, no raw syscalls, no unlogged shell. Credentials are encrypted
per-credential (X25519 ECDH + AES-256-GCM) and the daemon starts locked.
Sessions, hierarchical subsessions and a persistent `redb` database come with
per-session undo/redo. 70+ model providers are supported across
OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini wire protocols,
including OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Groq, Ollama and
OpenRouter. Native EVM and Substrate/Polkadot blockchain tools are built in.

## Key features

- Daemon + multi-client architecture (terminal, desktop, Telegram, ACP editors)
- Sandboxed RISC-V VM for LLM-generated code (a complete shell replacement)
- 70+ model providers out of the box
- Hierarchical subsessions with per-session undo/redo
- Encrypted credential keystore (X25519 ECDH + HKDF + AES-256-GCM)
- MCP client (Model Context Protocol)
- Native EVM + Polkadot/Substrate blockchain tools
- Persistent session-scoped database (redb)
- Written in Rust; Apache-2.0; runs locally or in the cloud
